name: Process Definition Service
description: Stores schemas and rules for process(es), Provides validation config, UI bundle, and label configuration.

name: Request Submission Service
description: Manages the submission process, generates UI using compiled bundles, Validates input using shared validation engine. Stores request (=submissions)

name: Civil Servant Review Service
description: Service that allows CivilServant to review the fields of request, submit comments Per-field or confirmqreject per field and an overall comment fo request.

name: Approval Workflow Service
description: Multi step approvals flow, costume configured for each process, managed using step functions infrastructure of AWS.

name: Notification Service
description: Listens to events, Sends email or SMS via SendGrid

name: Scanning System Service (separate account)
description: Manages scan request using Scanning workers, OPSWAT engine cluster, emit events according to scan results.

name: Attachment and Scanning Service
description: Presigned URLs for upload, Tracks attachments per submission, Sends scan jobs (to Scanning system), Processes scan results and emits events to notify other services.

name: SubmissionQueryService
description: Submission view, Consumes: cruital events and updates shallow view, One table to hold the truth for users
consumes: cruital events and updates shallow view, One table to hold the truth for users

name: Airs - AI Reponse Service
description: Service that manages the AI suggestion generation, based ob hystoric data, policy papers, local laws and the submitted request. This component can retrieve data basen on the properties of the authority (tenant) to make conclusions made on similarity with other authorities.

name: Document Service
description: Service that manages documents and their versions in the platform including long term storage of attachments, knowledge documents, policy documentation, committee decisions etc.

name: Shared Data Service
description: Hold shared data usually static or one that changes rarely and used by different services.

name: Task Service
description: Optional service that handles generation of tasks based on process definition and submitted requests, according to the step of the request.
